items.text: BESSENT SAYS RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL WILL PROCEED DESPITE LEGAL QUESTIONS Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the Trump administration has existing legal authority to implement its Russian diesel supply deal, rejecting claims that congressional legislation could block it. Bessent defended the agreement, saying it would help bring down U.S. diesel prices. “This is good for the American people.”

Treasury Secretary Bessent defends the deal, while Canada condemns it. Meanwhile, Trump’s Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire remains unconfirmed, with Kyiv awaiting details and Moscow silent.

GOLDMAN SACHS TURNS BULLISH ON STOCKS AND BONDS Goldman Sachs has upgraded equities to overweight over three months and bonds to overweight over 12 months. The bank sees improving valuations, resilient earnings and easing inflation supporting markets into 2027. Goldman favors AI-linked stocks and selective dividend plays, while warning that rising yields and geopolitical tensions could keep volatility elevated.

TRUMP'S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL UNLIKELY TO BRING PRICES DOWN Trump says Russia will release 4.8 million tons of diesel, equivalent to roughly 35.8 million barrels. That sounds substantial, but it would cover just nine days of U.S. diesel demand, according to EIA data. Only 300,000 tons are expected initially, while Ukrainian strikes have significantly constrained Russian refining capacity. FRANCE'S ECONOMY STALLS AS GROWTH HITS JUST 0.1% France's economy grew just 0.1% in Q3, following stagnation in Q2, according to the Bank of France. Rising energy costs, weak manufacturing and sluggish construction continue to weigh on growth. Business uncertainty is increasing, with companies delaying investments and households cutting spending. Automotive production could fall sharply in October due to supply shortages. Official Q3 GDP figures are due October 30.

IRAN ACCUSES UK OF STAGING FALSE FLAG ATTACK AT RAF FAIRFORD Iran's Foreign Ministry has categorically denied British accusations linking Tehran to a security incident at RAF Fairford. Tehran accused London of fabricating allegations and orchestrating a “false flag” operation, demanding concrete evidence to support the claims. Iran also warned that the British government would bear responsibility for any consequences arising from the accusations.

HSBC: DON'T FIGHT THE AI TRADE AS STOCK RALLY GAINS MOMENTUM HSBC expects strong Q3 earnings and accelerating AI demand to extend the equity bull market. S&P 500 forward valuations have fallen 16.5% since late 2025, while earnings guidance is improving at its fastest pace since 2021. The bank favors AI hyperscalers, citing surging computing demand and resilient GPU prices. HSBC sees earnings as the next catalyst for stocks to move higher.

KREMLIN DENIES TRUMP'S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL IS LINKED TO UKRAINE PEACE TALKS The Kremlin says Russia's diesel export agreement with the U.S. has no direct connection to negotiations over Ukraine. The denial follows a Reuters report that Trump's envoys presented the deal as an effort to bring Moscow back to peace talks. “I don't see any direct connection here,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said, calling the agreement mutually beneficial. FED'S WALLER: SURGING U.S. BOND YIELDS DRIVEN BY GROWTH, NOT INFLATION Fed Governor Christopher Waller says strong economic growth and AI investment are pushing Treasury yields higher, while inflation expectations remain anchored. He warns that weaker safe-haven demand for U.S. debt could be adding 50–70 basis points to yields. Waller expects the AI investment boom to continue for another 2–3 years.

IRAN WARNS U.S. OF MILITARY CONSEQUENCES AS OIL PRICES RISE Iranian officials have issued fresh warnings against U.S. military action, adding to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister warned that another U.S. military operation would have consequences extending beyond the region. Meanwhile, a senior IRGC commander declared that Iran is ready to respond to any new military aggression. Crude oil prices are moving higher amid the escalating rhetoric.
